local_models.configuration: model paths and container checks remain local; the desktop can start with a cloud TUI without weights

provider_authentication: Each user signs in through the provider client; authentication files and tokens are never distributed.

web_browser.engine: Microsoft Edge WebView2 through Qt WebView or the optional GG extension host
web_browser.scope: All WEB tabs, all HTTP/HTTPS sites
web_browser.delivery: Microsoft Evergreen Runtime, supplied and updated by Microsoft

content_blocking.delivery: Original publisher archive installed per user outside source
content_blocking.controls: Per-site on/off and the original uBO dashboard
content_blocking.compatibility: Verified on WebView2 155.0.4283.62; future Manifest V2 support depends on Microsoft

extension_host.sdk_delivery: Original Microsoft NuGet package during explicit build/install

windows.linux_workers: Configured Podman Linux VM; no host fallback without isolation

openssl.discovery: GG_OPENSSL_BINARY, PATH, installed Git for Windows

solana_validator.scope: Optional WSL/Linux local validator; not installed by CRYPTO optimization

solana_local_vm.scope: Local SVM execution and persisted public accounts; no consensus or mainnet sends

kaspa_node.scope: User-owned loopback simnet; read-only wRPC JSON adapter

kaspa_compiler.scope: Local compilation; covenant transitions remain paper simulations

public_spot_data.quote_currency: USDT; USD valuations are labelled estimates

pump_research.implementation: Independent Python; no installed trading SDK/framework
pump_research.rpc: Read-only https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com; unsigned simulateTransaction; no send/sign

gg_testnet.purpose: Optional owned loopback EVM development chain; never a production or P2P node
gg_testnet.installation_scope: Current user's GG tools directory; npm ci --ignore-scripts; no global packages or PATH changes
gg_testnet.windows_limits: Verified child-only Job Object: 512 MiB, 300 process CPU seconds, one process, kill on close and parent death
gg_testnet.audit: tmp overridden to patched 0.2.7; upstream Hardhat Zod 3 DoS advisory remains; see support/gg-testnet/README.md

omni_runtime.scope: Public reads, exact asset identities, session-local Ed25519 lab and offline WebCrypto verification; reviewed Solana execution uses the separate wallet adapter; no verified cross-chain bridge

gg_consensus.license: Apache-2.0; linked dependency notices copied by explicit installer
gg_consensus.scope: Four owned fixed-validator loopback processes; one physical host/operator; ephemeral account and validator keys
gg_consensus.light_client: Same SDK via Go WASM; fixed GG-session genesis/validator anchor; 256 KiB packet/3 s worker limit
gg_consensus.portability: Windows and Linux native execution verified; Android arm64 cross compile experimental, Android-only -checklinkname=0 recorded in receipt; physical phone not tested

gg_terminal.scope: Native text terminal and JSON; wallet watch, reviewed signing adapter, catalogue/passport and owned GG network; isolated terminal state; no Qt/browser dependency
gg_terminal.wallet_storage: Windows DPAPI; explicit password-unlocked POSIX scrypt-131072-8-1/AES-256-GCM; same encrypted backup and exact one-shot human operation guard

wallet_mnemonic.library: Trezor python-mnemonic 0.21, MIT, lazy English BIP39
wallet_mnemonic.derivation: SLIP-0010 Ed25519 m/44'/501'/0'/0'; current key creation adapter Solana
wallet_mnemonic.paper: Only public address and metadata persisted; no private key or phrase retained after Next
wallet_mnemonic.ai_assisted: Existing exact user approval per operation; local encrypted signing key and separately password-encrypted portable phrase
wallet_mnemonic.recovery: scrypt-131072-8-1/AES-256-GCM; authenticated public chain/address/path; no machine or GG account binding
wallet_mnemonic.secret_ui: Private local Qt/TTY only; GG image/text capture interlock; no public status, JSON, history or model output
wallet_mnemonic.hardware: Ledger/Tangem/external public watch addresses supported; native device signing not implemented or tested
